mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (account_id, instrument_id, side, quantity, price, status, received_at, idempotency_key) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{instrumentId}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{status}, #{receivedAt}, #{idempotencyKey})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, account_id AS accountId, instrument_id AS instrumentId, side, quantity, price, status, received_at AS receivedAt, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}

SELECT order_id AS orderId, account_id AS accountId, instrument_id AS instrumentId, side, quantity, price, status, received_at AS receivedAt, idempotency_key AS idempotencyKey FROM orders WHERE idempotency_key = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELLED' WHERE idempotency_key = #{id} AND status = 'NEW'
